title: MagMAX Enrichment & Extraction
author: Victor Mabasa
materials: Select the appropriate program on the instrument (Wastewater_10mL_Virus_Isolation)

steps.title: Prepare Enrichment and Lysis Plates
steps.instruction: Set up and label the Sample, Lysis, and Tip Comb plates outside of the instrument according to the specified requirements.

substeps.instruction: Sample plate 1 (Position 1, 24 deep-well): 5,000 µL Clarified supernatant
Dynabeads Wastewater Virus Enrichment beads (Position 1, 24 deep-well): 100 µL
Sample plate 2 (Position 2, 24 deep-well): 5,000 µL Clarified supernatant
Lysis plate (Position 3, 24 deep-well): 500 µL Lysis Buffer
Tip Comb plate (Position 4, 24 deep-well): Tip Comb

steps.title: Initiate Enrichment Run
steps.instruction: Start the instrument run and load the prepared sample and processing plates into position when prompted.

steps.title: Prepare Nucleic Acid Extraction Plates
steps.instruction: While the instrument is running, set up and label the Wash, Elution, and Tip Comb plates outside of the instrument.

substeps.instruction: Wash Buffer 1 (Position 1, 24 deep-well): 1,000 µL Wash Buffer
Elution plate (Position 3, 24 deep-well): 100 µL Elution Solution
Tip Comb plate (Position 4, 24 deep-well): Tip Comb

steps.title: Retrieve Lysis Plate
steps.instruction: Approximately 20 minutes after starting the run, remove the lysis plate from the instrument and store it safely for nucleic acid extraction; discard all other plates.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Extraction
steps.instruction: Add reagents to each enriched sample in the lysis plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 μL of Proteinase K to each sample.
Invert the Binding Bead Mix tube several times to resuspend beads, then add 520 µL of Binding Bead Mix to each sample.

steps.title: Run Nucleic Acid Extraction
steps.instruction: Load the plate into the instrument, start the run, and select the 'Wastewater_10mL_Virus_Extraction' program.

steps.title: Collect and Store Eluate
steps.instruction: Immediately remove the Elution plate from the instrument at the end of the run and cover it, or transfer the eluate to a new tube or plate.

substeps.instruction: For short-term storage, keep at –20°C for up to 6 months.
For long-term storage, keep at –80°C for longer than 6 months.
